notes:
Fixes being stuck on the loading screen after joining a match. Confirmed in a played match.

The cause was the intro bumper. To play its video, the launcher's game add-on hooked into the game's core event system, and that hook stayed in place for the whole match. With it there, the game never switched to the in-match screen, so the loading screen never went away. The hook is now only in place for the moment it is needed, and is switched off again straight after.

The intro bumper is now off by default while this is double-checked. You can turn it back on in Settings > Intro bumper.

This release also includes the hotbar fix from 1.9.6 and everything from 1.9.5 (faster matches, no ghost player, smoother updates).
